verdict.rationale: RingCentral's own materials name a no-code Workflow Builder and an Agentic Voice AI platform that automates customer interactions end-to-end. The AI Receptionist also answers and routes calls on its own, so the product does ship automation that runs without a user present. However, each of these is a one-line marketing or docs-navigation mention, with nothing on how automations are configured, triggered, scheduled or monitored. Missing for 10: documentation of Workflow Builder triggers, actions and recurring schedules; evidence of background execution without user presence; monitoring or run history; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
